title: Tracing the Path of Nepal’s Flood
summary_full: Mujib Mashal, our South Asia bureau chief, travels to points along a river in Nepal that turned into a deadly torrent, killing more than 1,300 people and leaving over 5,000 more missing as entire towns, bridges and roads were swept away.
